items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: Gene was doing an interview with Dave and he was asking him how did you get through World War II

ctx.x: Gene was doing an interview with Dave and he was asking him how did you get through World War II and what really affected you? And our dad was saying that he had a book he carried in his knapsack and it was sort of like a history of Europe or something, it was a very thick book which would be a funny thing for a trooper to have in his backpack along with an extra pair of boots and some socks. And he said because I kept reading this to find out, to get a sense of if I take myself out of my own lifetime where are…
And he wanted to spend more time, you know, with his kids and all that.
